detail.what_this_does_not_close: J-LOCATION is the completeness of the graph's predecessor relation.  The predecessors are derived from the successors, so this result plus LOC-DIRECT says the recorded successors are exactly the model's for every node whose bytes decide them; what remains open are the transfers this check excludes, which are LOC-RETURN and LOC-DISPATCH, and that is where J-LOCATION still rests on analysis/cfg.py
